3 recommended clinics in Tokyo that offer CoolSculpting! Compare treatment details and plan prices

「I want to receive CoolSculpting in Tokyo, but there are so many clinics that I don't know which one to choose.」

「What is the difference between fat cooling at an aesthetic salon and treatment at a medical clinic?」

Many people may have questions like the ones above.

CoolSculpting uses a pharmaceutically approved medical device developed by Allergan to physically reduce fat cells by cooling them.medical slimming treatmentIt is.

What is esthetic fat cooling?Approval of the device, physician involvement, sustainability of effectsThere are differences, so be sure to check them carefully.

In this article:3 recommended clinics offering CoolSculpting in TokyoIntroducing.

We will also explain how the treatment works and the criteria for choosing a clinic.

If you are thinking of receiving CoolSculpting in Tokyo, please refer to it.

What you can learn from this article
  • How CoolSculpting works and how you can lose weight with fat cooling
  • Three points that differ between fat cooling at an aesthetic salon and treatment at a medical clinic

Supervisor of this article

Yoshitomo Chihara

Director of Norris Beauty Clinic

Postdoctoral Researcher, Norris Cancer Center, University of Southern California;National Cancer Center PathologyHead of the club,Nara Prefectural Medical UniversityLecturer in Molecular Pathology,Saiseikai Chuwa HospitalAfter serving as head of the urology departmentnorris beauty clinicOpened a hospital.

Norris Beauty Clinic’s content production policy regarding aesthetic medicine

Norris Beauty Clinic operates with the aim of disseminating accurate and easy-to-understand information to our readers about aesthetic medicine, such as medical diets (GLP-1 receptor agonists, fat freezing, fat-dissolving injections, liposuction, etc.) and double plastic surgery.

Cosmetic treatments such as medical diets and double plastic surgery are important themes that are closely related to each individual's health condition, constitution, cost, and schedule.

We create content with an emphasis on reliability, neutrality, and safety so that our readers can calmly make choices that are suitable for them and prepare for advance counseling.

■Basic policy for content production

■Production flow

At our media, we create content through the following process.

Production flow
  1. Search needs/concerns survey
  2. Configuration design (organizing comparison standards and points to note)
  3. Writing/editing/fact checking
  4. Regular updates to the latest prices and medical system

■Regarding reliability of information

When writing articles, we use the following public institutions and highly reliable information sources.

An example of reference data for this media
  • Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare(Medical advertising guidelines/Pharmaceuticals Act related information)
  • PMDA (Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices Agency)
  • Japan Obesity Society・Japanese Society of Aesthetic Surgery (JSAS)Related academic societies such as
  • Consumer Affairs Agency(Related to the Specified Commercial Transactions Act and the Act on Premiums and Representations)
  • Official website information of each medical institution/pharmaceutical company

In addition, we regularly review information in response to price revisions, changes in clinic hours, updated guidelines, etc.

■Commitment to neutrality and transparency

Guaranteeing neutrality and objectivity
  • Specifies not only the benefits of each treatment but also side effects, risks, and downtime.
  • Presents points to note regarding total costs and cancellation regulations (cooling-off, etc.) for free medical treatment.
  • Do not use definitive expressions such as ``always'' or ``absolutely'' regarding changes or progress that vary from person to person.
  • Information is posted based on objective facts regardless of whether there is a partnership or not.

How CoolSculpting works and how you can lose weight with fat cooling

Cool sculpting iscooling energyThis is a medical slimming treatment that selectively kills fat cells using

Fat cells have the property of dying at a lower temperature than the surrounding skin and nerves, and this temperature difference is used to target only fat.

Three points: cooling mechanism, effect, and scope of application
  • Mechanism of medical slimming that reduces fat cells by cooling
  • How long does it take to see effects and the timeline after treatment?
  • Applicable range that targets subcutaneous fat and has no effect on visceral fat

After the treatment, dead fat cells are gradually eliminated by the body's immune system, and the fat layer thins over a period of weeks to months.

However, the areas where the effect appears arelimited to subcutaneous fatIt may not be suitable for people with a lot of visceral fat or obesity.

Below, we will explain in detail the mechanism, how it works, and the scope of application.

Mechanism of medical slimming that reduces fat cells by cooling

cool sculptingThe method uses a device called an applicator that is brought into close contact with the skin to approx.-11 degreesThis is a treatment that necrotizes fat cells by cooling the area to a certain temperature.

Fat cells are more sensitive to low temperatures than skin and muscle, and fat can be selectively reduced without damaging surrounding tissues.

necrotic fat cellsapoptosisThrough a process called natural cell death, the body's immune cells called macrophages gradually process it.

This process can take several weeks.3 monthsBecause it takes a while, it is difficult to notice any changes immediately after the treatment.

The percentage of fat cells reduced in one treatment is per treatment area.Approximately 20-25%It is said that

Estimated effect per treatment
  • Cooling temperature: Cooled to approximately -11 degrees
  • Fat cell reduction rate: Approximately 20-25% per treatment area
  • Period until the effect stabilizes: About 3 months after treatment
  • Dead fat cells do not regenerate, so long-term maintenance can be expected.

Once dead fat cells do not regenerate, the effect will last for a long time unless you gain a lot of weight.

This device, developed by Allergan, has received regulatory approval in Japan and is only approved for use in medical institutions.

When undergoing treatment, please be sure toAllergan Certified PhysicianChoose the clinic where you are enrolled.

How long does it take to see effects and the timeline after treatment?

The effects of CoolSculpting do not appear immediately after the treatment, but become visible gradually as dead fat cells are expelled from the body.

Immediately after the treatment, for about two weeks, you may experience temporary symptoms such as redness, swelling, and decreased sensation in the treated area.

After one month, the fat layer starts to thin and it becomes easier to feel the effects.2-3 months after treatmentIt is.

The final effect becomes stable from the treatment.After 3-6 monthsAt this point, the general procedure for follow-up is to check for changes in fat thickness.

If you experience severe pain or induration (symptoms of hardening of the subcutaneous tissue) that persist for a long time after the procedure, please consult your doctor.

There are some areas where you can expect more noticeable changes with multiple treatments.

After the second treatment, the effect of the first treatment was stable.After 3 monthsIt is common to do so.

Please discuss your treatment plan with your doctor.

Applicable range that targets subcutaneous fat and has no effect on visceral fat

What cool sculpting can do issubcutaneous fatHowever, visceral fat that accumulates deep in the abdomen is not covered.

The applicator is structured to deliver cooling energy from the surface of the skin, so it cannot physically reach internal organs.

Even if you are concerned about your stomach area, if the fat is mainly visceral fat, you may not get the desired effect even if you undergo surgery.

In many cases, the treatment is not suitable for people with a high BMI or a high degree of obesity, and a decision as to whether the treatment is appropriate or not will be made at the time of counseling.

The main areas where subcutaneous fat is targeted include the abdomen, flanks, thighs, upper arms, back, and chin.Thick enough to be pinched with an applicatorAreas with a mark are suitable for treatment.

Main areas for CoolSculpting
  • Abdomen (upper abdomen/lower abdomen)
  • flank
  • Thighs (inner/outer)
  • upper arm
  • back
  • submandibular
Annotation

*Target areas where the subcutaneous fat is thick enough to be pinched with the applicator.
It may not be suitable for people with high visceral fat or obesity.

Conversely, this treatment is suitable for people whose weight is within the normal range but who are concerned about fat in some areas.

Check the thickness of your subcutaneous fat during your pre-procedure consultation and ask your doctor whether your fat condition falls within the applicable range.

Three points that differ between fat cooling at an aesthetic salon and treatment at a medical clinic

Esthetic fat cooling and medical cliniccool sculptingAlthough they have similar names, they are fundamentally different treatments.

The biggest difference isAre you using genuine equipment that has received regulatory approval?It's all about how it works.

Three differences between aesthetic salons and medical clinics
  • Medical clinics use Allergan equipment that has received regulatory approval.
  • Physician involvement in treatment can reduce health risks
  • Difference between durability of effects and rebound risk

Whether a device is approved or not is directly linked to reduction of treatment risks, reproducibility of effects, sustainability of effects, etc.

If you try to choose a clinic by comparing only the prices, you will not be able to see this difference.

Before undergoing the treatment, consider the type of equipment, the level of involvement of the doctor, and the sustainability of the effect.Check 3 pointsThis will be the deciding factor when choosing a clinic.

Medical clinics use Allergan equipment that has received regulatory approval.

The official CoolSculpting equipment isallergan companyThis is a medical device manufactured by Japan that has obtained regulatory approval in Japan.

Pharmaceutical approvalis a certification given to products that have been approved for use by the Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare after examining their effectiveness, and the quality control standards are completely different from those for devices that have not been approved.

Only this approved equipment may be used in medical clinics.

On the other hand, many of the fat cooling devices installed in beauty salons are similar devices that have not received regulatory approval.

Similar devices do not guarantee the accuracy of the cooling temperature or the uniformity of the treatment energy, so not only will the desired effects not be obtained, but there is also a risk of damage to the skin.

There is no clinical data to support the effectiveness of non-approved devices used in aesthetic fat freezing, so it is difficult to predict the results of the treatment.

Allergan Certified PhysicianWhen choosing a clinic, please check whether or not the clinic is staffed by a licensed clinic.

Physician involvement in treatment can reduce health risks

At the medical clinic, we will conduct interviews before the procedure, determine suitability, manage the procedure during the procedure, and deal with side effects.Doctor takes charge。

CoolSculpting is classified as a medical procedure, soa physician or a health care worker under the supervision of a physician;can only be carried out.

Since treatments are performed at beauty salons without a doctor present, the response to any abnormalities that occur during the treatment will be very different from that at medical clinics.

Specifically, if severe pain or skin discoloration occurs at the treatment site, in an environment where a doctor is present, the treatment can be immediately stopped and the treatment performed, but in an aesthetic salon, there are only a limited number of measures that can be taken.

Also, determining suitability prior to treatment is an important process.

It is necessary to avoid performing the procedure on areas where the thickness of subcutaneous fat does not meet the standard or on people with circulatory system problems, but this judgment can only be made by a doctor.

Benefits of physician involvement
  • Interview and suitability determination before treatment (confirmation of subcutaneous fat thickness and circulatory system)
  • Immediate response to abnormalities (strong pain, skin discoloration) during treatment
  • Medical treatment when side effects occur
  • Follow-up after treatment and decision on additional treatment

If a problem occurs with fat freezing at an aesthetic salon, the salon that performed the treatment is legally unable to provide medical treatment.

If you experience any abnormalities after the procedure, please consult a medical institution.

Difference between durability of effects and rebound risk

Cool sculpting isPhysically kills fat cells themselvesIt's a treatment.

Dead fat cells are excreted from the body and are no longer regenerated.

The number of fat cells in adults basically remains constant, so even if you gain weight in areas where the number of cells has decreased, fat will continue to accumulate less easily than in other areas.

Difference in durability of effects: medical clinic vs aesthetic salon
  • Medical clinic: Physically kills and excretes fat cells, resulting in a permanent decrease in cell number
  • Medical clinic: Long-lasting effects unless you gain a lot of weight
  • Esthetics: Cannot provide enough cooling energy to kill fat cells
  • Aesthetics: The swelling improvement and metabolism promotion may only be temporary, and rebound is likely.

On the other hand, aesthetic fat cooling does not provide enough cooling energy to kill fat cells, so it may only temporarily improve swelling or accelerate metabolism.

Even if you feel a change immediately after the treatment, if the number of fat cells has not decreased, it will be easier to return to the original state when your diet and exercise amount change.

Approximately 1 session per treatment using official Allergan equipment20〜25%The goal is to reduce fat cells, and you can see more clear changes with multiple treatments.

If you are concerned about long-lasting results, choose CoolSculpting at a medical clinic, which physically reduces fat cells.

How to choose a clinic for CoolSculpting in Tokyo

There are many clinics in Tokyo that offer CoolSculpting.Genuine equipmentThere is a big difference in effectiveness depending on whether you use it or not.

The first thing you should check when choosing a clinic isAllergan CertificationThe question is whether the doctor who received the test is still on staff.

Three criteria and points to check when choosing a clinic
  • Check if Allergan-certified doctors are on staff and if official equipment is installed.
  • Compare the transparency of fees and the presence or absence of pay-as-you-go/monitoring systems
  • Check in advance to see which areas are easy to get to and how easy it is to make a reservation.
  • List of specific questions to ask during counseling

Availability of certified doctors, transparency of fees, ease of accessBy comparing on these three axes, you can narrow down the treatment destinations that suit your lifestyle and budget.

Organizing the information you need to check before counseling will help you make a choice you will not regret.

Check if Allergan-certified doctors are on staff and if official equipment is installed.

The first thing to check when choosing a clinic is whether they have doctors certified by Allergan.

An Allergan certified doctor is a doctor who has completed the prescribed training in CoolSculpting treatment techniques and management and has been officially certified by Allergan.

You can search for clinics with certified doctors on Allergan's official website.Be sure to check before bookingPlease.

Points to check to determine genuine equipment and certified doctors
  • Check the enrollment of certified doctors on Allergan's official website
  • Check to see if the device name is clearly listed on the clinic website.
  • Ask about the model number and number of devices installed during counseling.
  • If the answer is unclear, suspect the possibility of non-standard equipment.

Clinics that do not clearly indicate the presence of certified physicians or those that do not list device manufacturers are at risk of using similar devices that have not received regulatory approval.

CoolSculpting, which is an official device, uses different methods for each treatment area.applicator(Suction head) is designed to enable highly accurate cooling depending on the area such as the abdomen, flanks, and thighs.

Non-standard devices tend to have low reproducibility of effects because they are not optimized for each site.

Does the clinic clearly state the name of the device on its website, and does it indicate it during counseling?Can I confirm the model number and number of devices installed?This will also help determine whether the product is genuine or not.

Compare the transparency of fees and the presence or absence of pay-as-you-go/monitoring systems

CoolSculpting prices vary depending on the number of treatment areas, the size of the applicator, and the location of the clinic, but the average price per applicator is within Tokyo.Approximately 30,000 yen to 60,000 yenIt is.

When comparing prices, make sure that the amount shown isIs the price for 1 applicator or both sides set?Please check.

In abdominal treatments, there are many cases in which the applicator is applied to two areas, the left and right, and the price listed for only one side is only half of the actual treatment cost.

Three points that are easy to overlook when checking prices
  • Check whether the offered price is for one applicator or for both sides.
  • In the case of a monitor/first-time limited price, be sure to check the charges from the second time onwards.
  • Confirm in writing the refund conditions in the event of mid-term cancellation of the course contract.

Clinics that emphasize "monitor prices" or "first-time limited prices" may have prices set to significantly increase from the second visit onwards. Check the total cost in advance, assuming multiple treatments.

Clinics that accept pay-as-you-go options allow you to easily adjust the number of treatments at your own pace, making them suitable for those who want to try the treatment once before deciding whether to continue.

On the other hand, a course contract has the advantage of lowering the unit price per session,Refund conditions for mid-term cancellationBe sure to check this at the time of counseling.

Clinics that clearly display their price list on their website tend to have more transparent pricing and are less likely to incur additional costs.

Check in advance to see which areas are easy to get to and how easy it is to make a reservation.

CoolSculpting can be effective in some areas with just one treatment, but if you want to target multiple areas or wish to have additional treatments, you will need to visit the same clinic multiple times.

from work or homeWithin 30 minutesChoosing a clinic in an area that is easily accessible is effective in reducing the burden of canceling reservations and going to the hospital.

In Tokyo,Shinjuku, Shibuya, Ginza, Omotesando, IkebukuroCertified clinics are concentrated near major terminal stations, making it easy to compare multiple clinics.

The ease of making an appointment depends on the size of the clinic and the number of treatment equipment.

From initial counseling to treatment at popular clinicsCases where you have to wait 2 to 4 weeksThis is not uncommon, so if you have a specific date for your desired treatment, please contact us as soon as possible.

Clinics that have an online reservation system have the advantage of being able to check availability in real time, making it easier to adjust your schedule.

Clinics that offer clinic hours in the evenings and on weekends are a practical option for those who are unable to attend during the daytime on weekdays due to work commitments.

List of specific questions to ask during counseling

Counseling is important not only to determine the suitability of a treatment, but also to assess the reliability of the clinic.

Please list the following items in advance and compare the specificity and transparency of your answers.

List of questions to ask during counseling
  • Name, model number, and year of introduction of the equipment used
  • Approximate fat cell reduction rate that can be expected in your treatment area
  • Whether multiple treatments are recommended and its basis
  • Estimated duration of redness, swelling, and decreased sensation after treatment
  • Total amount of counseling fee, treatment fee, and aftercare fee (confirmed in writing)
  • Whether the doctor in charge will provide direct explanations before the procedure

When checking the equipment used,Equipment name/model number/years of introductionLet's listen.

If it is a genuine Allergan product, the person in charge will be able to give you an answer right away, and if the answer is unclear, this is grounds for suspicion that it may be a non-genuine device.

How effective is one treatment?

How much downtime will it take?

CoolSculpting downtime compared to other medical slimming treatmentsshort categoryEnter.

Immediately after the treatment, there may be some redness, swelling, or temporary numbness in the treatment area for several days.

These reactions are temporary tissue reactions due to cooling, and in many casesWithin 1-2 weekscalm down naturally.

One of the reasons why it is chosen as a treatment that does not require hospitalization or long-term rest is that it is possible to return to daily life or light work from the day of the treatment.

However, avoid massaging or applying strong pressure to the affected area for several days after the treatment.

If you experience strong pain or swelling that persists for more than a week after the treatment, do not leave it alone and contact the clinic where you received the treatment.

We also recommend that you refrain from activities that significantly raise your body temperature, such as strenuous exercise or saunas, for about a week after your treatment.

Is there a risk of rebound after treatment?

Fat cells killed by CoolSculpting arewill never play again。

Once the number of fat cells has been reduced, it will not return to its original state, so fat in the treated area will remain difficult to increase for a long time.

This point is a big difference from diets that only shrink fat cells or general slimming beauty treatments.

Concept of rebound risk
  • Dead fat cells do not regenerate, so the decrease in cell number is permanent.
  • Even when you gain weight, the treated area remains less likely to accumulate fat than other areas.
  • If significant weight gain continues, there is a risk that remaining fat cells will enlarge.
  • Managing your diet and maintaining a moderate exercise routine will lead to long-term effects.

However, if you continue to gain significant weight after the procedure, there is a risk that your body shape may change due to the enlargement of remaining fat cells.

after the treatmentMaintain a proper diet and exercise habitsBy doing so, you can maintain the obtained effects for a long time.

CoolSculpting's strength is that it is a treatment that reduces the number of fat cells itself, so the effects are likely to last as long as you maintain an appropriate lifestyle.

Adjusting your lifestyle habits after treatment will help you maintain your body shape over the long term.

Visceral fat is fat that accumulates around organs in the abdominal cavity and cannot receive cooling energy from the body surface, so the treatment is not applicable.

If your BMI is high and you have a lot of visceral fat, you may not be able to have a sufficient layer of subcutaneous fat, and you may not be able to receive the treatment itself.
